region: St. Moritz, Engadin and the Bernina railway
method: Official operator and destination sources checked through web search and page fetches. Published timetables are not a live operating guarantee; availability and the user's purchased tickets were not accessible.

priority_corrections.finding: After the user-supplied12:35 arrival, luggage and lunch at Hotel San Gian, prioritise Silvaplanersee and Silsersee using601 outward,605 between shore walks,601 return. Lake St Moritz is a nearby fallback. Published departure candidates require live reconfirmation because current diversions affect stop times.

Muottas Muragl is a valid October 21 sunset/dinner plan. The official 2026 summer season runs through October 25; the panoramic restaurant serves its evening menu 18:00–21:00; the funicular publishes a final descent at 23:00. Weather, a table and the return transport still need checking.

Corvatsch summer service ends October 16, so exclude it from October 20–22. Diavolezza remains a possible sightseeing alternative: the cable car and Berghaus operate daily October 17–November 15, 07:40–16:20. Skiing starts October 24 on selected weekdays; that does not mean the cable car is closed to pedestrians on October 21.

Do not promise the San Gian church interior in Celerina. Its published 2026 public viewing season ends October 15. Enjoy the exterior, or request a private tour from Celerina tourist information; no private availability has been confirmed.

Santa Maria in Pontresina is a stronger confirmed interior visit for Christian history. Weekday public access is 15:30–17:30 through October 23, and a free guided visit is specifically listed for Wednesday October 21, 17:00–17:30. Choose self-visit at 15:30 to protect the mountain sunset, or the guided visit and a later dinner.

Ovaverva is open for this stay. It reopened May 6, 2026 after renovation; its next maintenance closure is November 16–29. San Gian advertises complimentary guest access. The pool and spa run to 22:00 on October 20/21, with last admission one hour before closing.

Segantini Museum is a possible October 20 arrival-afternoon alternative, but closes after October 20 and cannot be the October 21 rain fallback. Museum Engiadinais has conflicting general and date-specific text and is closed on Wednesdays regardless; exclude it from the October 21 plan.

Regional Bernina trains and the panoramic Bernina Express use the same scenic line. Express panoramic seats require a paid reservation plus a ticket. Regional seat reservations are optional and currently cost CHF 5 per person per direction; do not claim that regional seats cannot be reserved.

Tirano–St. Moritz covers the Bernina line and Brusio spiral, Lago Bianco and Alp Grüm. It does not include the Landwasser Viaduct, which belongs to the Albula route towards Chur. Do not use the operator's Chur–Tirano full-route statistics as if they describe this shorter journey.

october20_milano_tirano.verification: The current official Trenord route page corroborates a first departure at 06:20 and a duration around 2½ hours. Arrival 08:52 and actual October 20 service were not independently retrieved from a date-specific journey result; retain these as user-supplied times, to check against ticket and live planner.

october20_tirano_stmoritz.verification: These times are corroborated in the search-indexed official RhB 2026 Sales Manual / Bernina Express factsheet as panoramic Bernina Express 972. The original PDF URLs failed direct fetch in this session, so the specific train and live availability must still be checked against the ticket/booking. Do not label this time slot a confirmed regional departure.

tirano_connection.advice: Keep the existing buffer: allow time for breakfast, luggage and the separate RhB station. Avoid adding the Madonna di Tirano sanctuary into this connection; it creates unnecessary luggage and walking pressure. If the Italian train is disrupted, check the next regional Bernina departure rather than assuming a panoramic reservation transfers automatically.

october22_to_varenna.advice: Book/check an early morning regional departure and a sensible Tirano connection; reserve approximately 4½–5 hours door to door as a planning allowance, then replace with the live route. Aim to reach Varenna by early afternoon. Do not wait for a late panoramic train merely to repeat the scenic route. This duration is an itinerary allowance, not an independently confirmed timetable.

travel.station_access: Trenord warns of short platforms at both Tirano and Varenna-Esino: do not use the final coaches to board/alight; follow on-board instructions.
travel.disruption_audit: The indexed Italian Lecco–Tirano summer closure and October 17–19 notices commonly surfaced in search refer to 2025, not 2026; they must not be transplanted onto this trip. A separate current 2026 Milano/Monza notice ended October 9. No date-specific October 20/22 all-clear was established. Check Trenord line alerts and RhB/SBB again the evening before and morning of travel. RhB's October Bernina works PDF is a night-noise/works calendar, not proof of a daytime suspension. The Bernina Express Vereina diversion begins October 29, after this trip.

recommended_days.theme: Bernina railway, hotel luggage drop and two priority Engadin lakes.
recommended_days.schedule_type: User-supplied12:35 train arrival; published bus timetable candidates; estimated activity blocks and OSRM pedestrian measurements.

plan.title: St Moritz station to Hotel San Gian
plan.detail: Take601 to Via San Gian, about11minutes;609 at13:01 (~7minutes) or taxi is backup. Walk about5–10minutes to Via San Gian23. Leave luggage if room not ready; quick lunch and request actual hotel-issued transport pass.

plan.title: Silvaplanersee first
plan.detail: 601 from Via San Gian to Silvaplana Rundella Curtins (~14:07), then pedestrian route via Mandra, Mulets shore and Senda dal Lej photo turn to Camping. Measured1,737.7m,26min moving at4km/h; allow30–35min with brief pauses, arrive Camping14:40–14:42.14:27 bus is a backup.

plan.title: Silsersee and Chastè approach
plan.detail: 605 from Camping to Sils/Segl Maria Posta (~7min). Walk directly toward Chastè approach at eastern Silsersee shore and return same route to Posta. Measured2,832.6m,42min moving; allow55–65min with photos. Do not detour through Baselgia village or add full Chastè circuit by default. Backup15:17Camping→15:24Posta shifts walk to15:30; shorten if needed and use checked16:57return.

plan.title: 601 back to hotel
plan.detail: Sils/Segl Maria Posta to Via San Gian, roughly30–35min on printed route, plus walk to San Gian. Check live time/destination because current diversions change stop times. Finish shore walking by16:30; hotel around17:00–17:30, then dinner/optional short spa.

recommended_days.food: A slice of Engadiner Nusstorte is a good low-pressure local treat; San Gian sells its own at reception. For a regional dinner, ask what is actually on the current menu rather than assuming capuns is always available.
recommended_days.rain_plan: Shorten both shores if a safe dry window remains. If delayed/insufficient daylight, visit one lake and give the other priority in21October landscape slot. Persistent rain/ice: replace outing with Segantini today (last seasonal day), Ovaverva or Forum. Local St Moritz lake remains fallback.

recommended_days.theme: A gentle valley morning, medieval Christian art, and one panoramic evening.
recommended_days.schedule_type: Proposed times; only published admission/dining/lift windows are verified

plan.title: Choose Lej da Staz OR Celerina
plan.detail: Choose one outing after breakfast. In dry, ice-free conditions, Lej da Staz offers a forest/lake walk; official tourism estimates around50 minutes each way from Celerina, so allow2–2½ hours with pauses. Otherwise stroll Celerina's decorated Engadin houses and see San Gian from outside. Golden larches are a possibility, not a guaranteed foliage forecast.

plan.title: Lunch, rest, then Pontresina
plan.detail: Leave an unhurried lunch and rest block. Transfer to Pontresina, stroll the village and look for sgraffito. Do not add a Diavolezza excursion to this base plan.

plan.title: Santa Maria church interior
plan.detail: Visit when its weekday opening begins. The church's medieval murals include Byzantine-Romanesque fragments and a15th-century Lombard cycle. This fits Christian history better than promising a locked Celerina interior.

plan.title: Reach Punt Muragl and ascend
plan.detail: Allow at least45–60 minutes from the church, including the walk down, an actual bus/train departure and the10-minute funicular. Check the specific connection in SBB. A16:45 or17:15 ascent is a planning target, not a guaranteed connection. Keep a spare layer for the viewpoint.

plan.title: Muottas Muragl dinner for two
plan.detail: Request a window table, have an earlier apéritif/viewpoint pause, then dinner. The evening menu is published18:00–21:00; the23:00 final funicular does not guarantee a late bus back to San Gian. Check the evening return and arrange a taxi fallback through the hotel if needed.

recommended_days.alternative_for_guided_christian_history: Take the confirmed free Santa Maria guided visit17:00–17:30 and move Muottas dinner to19:00 or later; this sacrifices much of the sunset/viewpoint margin. Choose this deliberately rather than putting both options into one rigid schedule. Confirm the tour language locally.
recommended_days.alternative_mountain: If October21 is clearly sunny, you prefer glaciers to churches, and the operator confirms conditions, replace the valley morning with a half-day Diavolezza cable-car trip. Return to the valley well before the final descent; do not stack Diavolezza, Staz, Celerina and Muottas in one day.
recommended_days.rain_plan: Skip the mountain if cloud obscures the views. Have a slow café morning, a longer Ovaverva visit and the Santa Maria afternoon interior visit, then dinner at the hotel. Keep outdoor walking short if wet or icy. Segantini is closed October21; Museum Engiadinais is not a reliable Wednesday fallback.
contact_actions: Ask San Gian which two-night mountain-railway/public-transport pass is included and collect it before buying duplicate lift tickets; verify evening and arrival/departure-day validity.
Ask Muottas for a table and its cancellation policy, then choose the forecast-best evening, October20 or21, if flexibility is available.
Check trail condition with reception on the morning rather than assuming summer lake paths are ice-free.

sources.title: RhB — Bernina Express or regional train?
sources.evidence: Both operate on the same UNESCO Bernina line. Express requires ticket plus paid reservation; regional service offers optional reservations. Bernina highlights areBrusio circular viaduct,AlpGrüm,LagoBianco. Avoid confusing tickets marketed simply asTreninoRosso with panoramic Express reservations.
